hdmi_in.description: The HDMI-in jack: an HDMI receiver (bayerlink-fpga's hdmi_rx, the implementation front_end names) decoding the cable to parallel video, the hot-plug and DDC lines, and the pins they land on. Every design on this board that receives bayerlink uses this block rather than restating any of it. The link's rate is one parameter: the jack's clock is constrained at it, and the front end's clocking is set for it.

lane_map.description: Which video lane carries container byte 0, 1, 2: a fact of the front end filling dvi_rx, for the receiver behind this jack.

vsync_active_high.description: The frame pulse's polarity, as the front end delivers it.

link_khz.description: The link's pixel clock, in kHz: the rate the receiver advertises and the source sends. The TMDS pin's clock is constrained at it and the front end set for it.

front_end.description: Which implementation of bayerlink-fpga's hdmi_rx receives the link: Digilent's dvi2rgb, or tmds_rx, bayerlink-fpga's own, which also gives its account of the link on `status`.

inputs.name: refclk
inputs.description: 200 MHz, for the front end's delay calibration.

inputs.name: sda_pull
inputs.description: The DDC slave pulling SDA low.

outputs.name: pclk
outputs.description: The clock recovered from the link: it stops when the cable is pulled.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: The receiver's account of the link: tmds_rx's status word.
